sections.content:
Mr. Yogesh Dhanawade (Alumni) Vice-President, Alumni Association of APCOER 8600850758 yogeshdh99@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/yogeshdh99
Our journey began at institute, where we nurtured, guided, and molded into the individuals what we are today. The knowledge, skills, and friendships we acquired during our time here have been instrumental in shaping our paths. As we move forward, I encourage you to stay connected with our Alumni Association, participate in our events, and share your ideas and feedback with us. Your involvement is vital to the success of our association, and we look forward to working with you to achieve our mission and goals.
